en.house_plan_help: Floor plan in meters (x to the right, y downwards), floors from bottom to top. Empty = the example house. Example: {"floors":[{"id":"gf","name":"Ground floor","short":"GF","h":2.7,"foot":[[0,0],[10,0],[10,8],[0,8]],"rooms":[{"id":"living","name":"Living room","p":[[0,0],[6,0],[6,5],[0,5]],"accent":"home"},{"id":"stairs","name":"Stairs","kind":"stairs","p":[[6,0],[7,0],[7,3],[6,3]]}]}],"roof":{"base":"gf","pitch":35,"ridge":"x","knee":1}}. h = storey height, foot = outline of the floor, p = corners of a room, kind = room | outside | stairs, accent = home, grid, sun, heat, cool, ok … or #rrggbb, "attic":true for a floor under the roof, "roof" is optional. Write {" without a space between { and ".
en.house_devices_help: List of devices. Example: [{"id":"l1","type":"light","room":"living","uv":[0.5,0.5],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.light","label":"Ceiling light"},{"id":"t1","type":"thermostat","room":"living","uv":[0.1,0.9],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.temp","oidSet":"0_userdata.0.living.setpoint"}]. type = light | plug | motion | window | thermostat | temperature | shutter. Position: uv = [0…1, 0…1] inside the room (0,0 = top left corner of the room) or at = [x, y] in meters together with "floor". oid = state that is shown; oidSet = state that lights and plugs write (default: oid) or the setpoint of a thermostat. Optional: floor, label, unit, dec, icon, accent. Tapping a light or plug switches it. Empty = demo devices of the example house.
en.house_start_floor_tip: ID of a floor from the plan; empty = all floors
en.house_start_room_tip: ID of a room (or floor/room); opens the room view at start
en.house_wall_height_tip: Share of the storey height that the walls get in the exploded view
en.house_no_devices: No devices in this room yet.
en.house_aria: 3D model of the house with %s floors
en.house_err_dev_skipped: skipped without a valid room or floor: %s

de.house_plan_help: Grundriss in Metern (x nach rechts, y nach unten), Geschosse von unten nach oben. Leer = das Beispielhaus. Beispiel: {"floors":[{"id":"eg","name":"Erdgeschoss","short":"EG","h":2.7,"foot":[[0,0],[10,0],[10,8],[0,8]],"rooms":[{"id":"wohnen","name":"Wohnzimmer","p":[[0,0],[6,0],[6,5],[0,5]],"accent":"home"},{"id":"treppe","name":"Treppe","kind":"stairs","p":[[6,0],[7,0],[7,3],[6,3]]}]}],"roof":{"base":"eg","pitch":35,"ridge":"x","knee":1}}. h = Geschosshöhe, foot = Umriss des Geschosses, p = Ecken eines Raums, kind = room | outside | stairs, accent = home, grid, sun, heat, cool, ok … oder #rrggbb, "attic":true für ein Geschoss unter dem Dach, "roof" ist optional. {" ohne Leerzeichen zwischen { und " schreiben.
de.house_devices_help: Liste der Geräte. Beispiel: [{"id":"l1","type":"light","room":"wohnen","uv":[0.5,0.5],"oid":"0_userdata.0.wohnen.licht","label":"Deckenlicht"},{"id":"t1","type":"thermostat","room":"wohnen","uv":[0.1,0.9],"oid":"0_userdata.0.wohnen.temp","oidSet":"0_userdata.0.wohnen.soll"}]. type = light | plug | motion | window | thermostat | temperature | shutter. Position: uv = [0…1, 0…1] im Raum (0,0 = linke obere Ecke des Raums) oder at = [x, y] in Metern zusammen mit "floor". oid = angezeigter Datenpunkt; oidSet = Datenpunkt, den Lichter und Steckdosen schreiben (sonst oid), oder der Sollwert eines Thermostats. Optional: floor, label, unit, dec, icon, accent. Antippen schaltet Lichter und Steckdosen. Leer = Demo-Geräte des Beispielhauses.
de.house_start_floor_tip: ID eines Geschosses aus dem Grundriss; leer = alle Geschosse
de.house_start_room_tip: ID eines Raums (oder Geschoss/Raum); öffnet beim Start die Raumansicht
de.house_wall_height_tip: Anteil der Geschosshöhe, den die Wände in der aufgefächerten Ansicht bekommen
de.house_no_devices: In diesem Raum ist noch kein Gerät eingebunden.
de.house_err_dev_skipped: ohne gültigen Raum oder Geschoss übersprungen: %s

ru.house_plan_help: План этажей в метрах (x вправо, y вниз), этажи снизу вверх. Пусто = пример дома. Пример: {"floors":[{"id":"gf","name":"Первый этаж","short":"1","h":2.7,"foot":[[0,0],[10,0],[10,8],[0,8]],"rooms":[{"id":"living","name":"Гостиная","p":[[0,0],[6,0],[6,5],[0,5]],"accent":"home"},{"id":"stairs","name":"Лестница","kind":"stairs","p":[[6,0],[7,0],[7,3],[6,3]]}]}],"roof":{"base":"gf","pitch":35,"ridge":"x","knee":1}}. h = высота этажа, foot = контур этажа, p = углы комнаты, kind = room | outside | stairs, accent = home, grid, sun, heat, cool, ok … или #rrggbb, "attic":true для этажа под крышей, "roof" необязателен. Пишите {" без пробела между { и ".
ru.house_devices_help: Список устройств. Пример: [{"id":"l1","type":"light","room":"living","uv":[0.5,0.5],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.light","label":"Потолочный свет"},{"id":"t1","type":"thermostat","room":"living","uv":[0.1,0.9],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.temp","oidSet":"0_userdata.0.living.setpoint"}]. type = light | plug | motion | window | thermostat | temperature | shutter. Положение: uv = [0…1, 0…1] внутри комнаты (0,0 = левый верхний угол комнаты) или at = [x, y] в метрах вместе с "floor". oid = отображаемая точка данных; oidSet = точка данных, в которую пишут светильники и розетки (по умолчанию: oid), или уставка термостата. Необязательно: floor, label, unit, dec, icon, accent. Нажатие на светильник или розетку переключает их. Пусто = демо-устройства примера дома.
ru.house_start_floor_tip: ID этажа из плана; пусто = все этажи
ru.house_start_room_tip: ID комнаты (или этаж/комната); при запуске открывает вид комнаты
ru.house_wall_height_tip: Доля высоты этажа, которую получают стены в разнесённом виде
ru.house_hint: Перетащите для поворота · двойной щелчок — сброс
ru.house_no_devices: В этой комнате пока нет устройств.
ru.house_err_no_floors: не найдено ни одного допустимого этажа (ожидается "floors":[…])
ru.house_err_dev_skipped: пропущены без допустимой комнаты или этажа: %s

pt.house_plan_help: Planta em metros (x para a direita, y para baixo), andares de baixo para cima. Vazio = a casa de exemplo. Exemplo: {"floors":[{"id":"gf","name":"Térreo","short":"T","h":2.7,"foot":[[0,0],[10,0],[10,8],[0,8]],"rooms":[{"id":"living","name":"Sala de estar","p":[[0,0],[6,0],[6,5],[0,5]],"accent":"home"},{"id":"stairs","name":"Escada","kind":"stairs","p":[[6,0],[7,0],[7,3],[6,3]]}]}],"roof":{"base":"gf","pitch":35,"ridge":"x","knee":1}}. h = altura do andar, foot = contorno do andar, p = cantos de um cômodo, kind = room | outside | stairs, accent = home, grid, sun, heat, cool, ok … ou #rrggbb, "attic":true para um andar sob o telhado, "roof" é opcional. Escreva {" sem espaço entre { e ".
pt.house_devices_help: Lista de dispositivos. Exemplo: [{"id":"l1","type":"light","room":"living","uv":[0.5,0.5],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.light","label":"Luz de teto"},{"id":"t1","type":"thermostat","room":"living","uv":[0.1,0.9],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.temp","oidSet":"0_userdata.0.living.setpoint"}]. type = light | plug | motion | window | thermostat | temperature | shutter. Posição: uv = [0…1, 0…1] dentro do cômodo (0,0 = canto superior esquerdo do cômodo) ou at = [x, y] em metros junto com "floor". oid = ponto de dados exibido; oidSet = ponto de dados em que luzes e tomadas escrevem (padrão: oid) ou o valor desejado de um termostato. Opcional: floor, label, unit, dec, icon, accent. Tocar em uma luz ou tomada a liga ou desliga. Vazio = dispositivos de demonstração da casa de exemplo.
pt.house_start_floor_tip: ID de um andar da planta; vazio = todos os andares
pt.house_start_room_tip: ID de um cômodo (ou andar/cômodo); abre a visualização do cômodo ao iniciar
pt.house_wall_height_tip: Fração da altura do andar que as paredes recebem na visualização explodida
pt.house_hint: Arraste para girar · clique duplo redefine
pt.house_no_devices: Ainda não há dispositivos neste cômodo.
pt.house_err_dev_skipped: ignorados sem cômodo ou andar válido: %s

nl.house_plan_help: Plattegrond in meters (x naar rechts, y naar beneden), verdiepingen van onder naar boven. Leeg = het voorbeeldhuis. Voorbeeld: {"floors":[{"id":"gf","name":"Begane grond","short":"BG","h":2.7,"foot":[[0,0],[10,0],[10,8],[0,8]],"rooms":[{"id":"living","name":"Woonkamer","p":[[0,0],[6,0],[6,5],[0,5]],"accent":"home"},{"id":"stairs","name":"Trap","kind":"stairs","p":[[6,0],[7,0],[7,3],[6,3]]}]}],"roof":{"base":"gf","pitch":35,"ridge":"x","knee":1}}. h = verdiepingshoogte, foot = omtrek van de verdieping, p = hoeken van een ruimte, kind = room | outside | stairs, accent = home, grid, sun, heat, cool, ok … of #rrggbb, "attic":true voor een verdieping onder het dak, "roof" is optioneel. Schrijf {" zonder spatie tussen { en ".
nl.house_devices_help: Lijst van apparaten. Voorbeeld: [{"id":"l1","type":"light","room":"living","uv":[0.5,0.5],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.light","label":"Plafondlamp"},{"id":"t1","type":"thermostat","room":"living","uv":[0.1,0.9],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.temp","oidSet":"0_userdata.0.living.setpoint"}]. type = light | plug | motion | window | thermostat | temperature | shutter. Positie: uv = [0…1, 0…1] binnen de ruimte (0,0 = linkerbovenhoek van de ruimte) of at = [x, y] in meters samen met "floor". oid = datapunt dat wordt getoond; oidSet = datapunt waarnaar lampen en stekkers schrijven (standaard: oid) of de gewenste waarde van een thermostaat. Optioneel: floor, label, unit, dec, icon, accent. Tikken op een lamp of stekker schakelt deze. Leeg = demo-apparaten van het voorbeeldhuis.
nl.house_start_floor_tip: ID van een verdieping uit de plattegrond; leeg = alle verdiepingen
nl.house_start_room_tip: ID van een ruimte (of verdieping/ruimte); opent bij de start de ruimteweergave
nl.house_wall_height_tip: Deel van de verdiepingshoogte dat de wanden in de uiteengelegde weergave krijgen
nl.house_hint: Slepen om te draaien · dubbelklik zet terug
nl.house_no_devices: In deze ruimte zijn nog geen apparaten.
nl.house_err_dev_skipped: overgeslagen zonder geldige ruimte of verdieping: %s

fr.house_plan_help: Plan en mètres (x vers la droite, y vers le bas), niveaux de bas en haut. Vide = la maison d'exemple. Exemple : {"floors":[{"id":"gf","name":"Rez-de-chaussée","short":"RDC","h":2.7,"foot":[[0,0],[10,0],[10,8],[0,8]],"rooms":[{"id":"living","name":"Salon","p":[[0,0],[6,0],[6,5],[0,5]],"accent":"home"},{"id":"stairs","name":"Escalier","kind":"stairs","p":[[6,0],[7,0],[7,3],[6,3]]}]}],"roof":{"base":"gf","pitch":35,"ridge":"x","knee":1}}. h = hauteur d'étage, foot = contour du niveau, p = coins d'une pièce, kind = room | outside | stairs, accent = home, grid, sun, heat, cool, ok … ou #rrggbb, "attic":true pour un niveau sous le toit, "roof" est facultatif. Écrivez {" sans espace entre { et ".
fr.house_devices_help: Liste des appareils. Exemple : [{"id":"l1","type":"light","room":"living","uv":[0.5,0.5],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.light","label":"Plafonnier"},{"id":"t1","type":"thermostat","room":"living","uv":[0.1,0.9],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.temp","oidSet":"0_userdata.0.living.setpoint"}]. type = light | plug | motion | window | thermostat | temperature | shutter. Position : uv = [0…1, 0…1] dans la pièce (0,0 = coin supérieur gauche de la pièce) ou at = [x, y] en mètres avec "floor". oid = point de données affiché ; oidSet = point de données écrit par les lumières et les prises (par défaut : oid) ou la consigne d'un thermostat. Facultatif : floor, label, unit, dec, icon, accent. Toucher une lumière ou une prise la commute. Vide = appareils de démo de la maison d'exemple.
fr.house_start_floor_tip: ID d'un niveau du plan ; vide = tous les niveaux
fr.house_start_room_tip: ID d'une pièce (ou niveau/pièce) ; ouvre la vue de la pièce au démarrage
fr.house_wall_height_tip: Part de la hauteur d'étage attribuée aux murs dans la vue éclatée
fr.house_room_view: Vue de la pièce au toucher
fr.house_hint: Faites glisser pour pivoter · double-clic pour réinitialiser
fr.house_no_devices: Aucun appareil dans cette pièce pour l'instant.
fr.house_aria: Maquette 3D de la maison avec %s niveaux
fr.house_err_dev_skipped: ignorés sans pièce ni niveau valide : %s

it.house_plan_help: Pianta in metri (x verso destra, y verso il basso), piani dal basso verso l'alto. Vuoto = la casa di esempio. Esempio: {"floors":[{"id":"gf","name":"Piano terra","short":"PT","h":2.7,"foot":[[0,0],[10,0],[10,8],[0,8]],"rooms":[{"id":"living","name":"Soggiorno","p":[[0,0],[6,0],[6,5],[0,5]],"accent":"home"},{"id":"stairs","name":"Scala","kind":"stairs","p":[[6,0],[7,0],[7,3],[6,3]]}]}],"roof":{"base":"gf","pitch":35,"ridge":"x","knee":1}}. h = altezza del piano, foot = contorno del piano, p = angoli di una stanza, kind = room | outside | stairs, accent = home, grid, sun, heat, cool, ok … o #rrggbb, "attic":true per un piano sotto il tetto, "roof" è facoltativo. Scrivi {" senza spazio tra { e ".
it.house_devices_help: Elenco dei dispositivi. Esempio: [{"id":"l1","type":"light","room":"living","uv":[0.5,0.5],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.light","label":"Luce a soffitto"},{"id":"t1","type":"thermostat","room":"living","uv":[0.1,0.9],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.temp","oidSet":"0_userdata.0.living.setpoint"}]. type = light | plug | motion | window | thermostat | temperature | shutter. Posizione: uv = [0…1, 0…1] all'interno della stanza (0,0 = angolo in alto a sinistra della stanza) oppure at = [x, y] in metri insieme a "floor". oid = punto dati visualizzato; oidSet = punto dati su cui scrivono luci e prese (predefinito: oid) oppure il setpoint di un termostato. Facoltativi: floor, label, unit, dec, icon, accent. Toccando una luce o una presa la si commuta. Vuoto = dispositivi demo della casa di esempio.
it.house_start_floor_tip: ID di un piano della pianta; vuoto = tutti i piani
it.house_start_room_tip: ID di una stanza (o piano/stanza); all'avvio apre la vista della stanza
it.house_wall_height_tip: Quota dell'altezza del piano assegnata alle pareti nella vista esplosa
it.house_hint: Trascina per ruotare · doppio clic per ripristinare
it.house_err_dev_skipped: ignorati senza stanza o piano valido: %s

es.house_plan_help: Plano en metros (x hacia la derecha, y hacia abajo), plantas de abajo arriba. Vacío = la casa de ejemplo. Ejemplo: {"floors":[{"id":"gf","name":"Planta baja","short":"PB","h":2.7,"foot":[[0,0],[10,0],[10,8],[0,8]],"rooms":[{"id":"living","name":"Salón","p":[[0,0],[6,0],[6,5],[0,5]],"accent":"home"},{"id":"stairs","name":"Escalera","kind":"stairs","p":[[6,0],[7,0],[7,3],[6,3]]}]}],"roof":{"base":"gf","pitch":35,"ridge":"x","knee":1}}. h = altura de planta, foot = contorno de la planta, p = esquinas de una habitación, kind = room | outside | stairs, accent = home, grid, sun, heat, cool, ok … o #rrggbb, "attic":true para una planta bajo el tejado, "roof" es opcional. Escribe {" sin espacio entre { y ".
es.house_devices_help: Lista de dispositivos. Ejemplo: [{"id":"l1","type":"light","room":"living","uv":[0.5,0.5],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.light","label":"Luz de techo"},{"id":"t1","type":"thermostat","room":"living","uv":[0.1,0.9],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.temp","oidSet":"0_userdata.0.living.setpoint"}]. type = light | plug | motion | window | thermostat | temperature | shutter. Posición: uv = [0…1, 0…1] dentro de la habitación (0,0 = esquina superior izquierda de la habitación) o at = [x, y] en metros junto con "floor". oid = punto de datos que se muestra; oidSet = punto de datos en el que escriben luces y enchufes (por defecto: oid) o la consigna de un termostato. Opcional: floor, label, unit, dec, icon, accent. Al tocar una luz o un enchufe, se conmuta. Vacío = dispositivos de demostración de la casa de ejemplo.
es.house_start_floor_tip: ID de una planta del plano; vacío = todas las plantas
es.house_start_room_tip: ID de una habitación (o planta/habitación); abre la vista de la habitación al inicio
es.house_wall_height_tip: Proporción de la altura de planta que reciben las paredes en la vista de despiece
es.house_roof: Tejado en la vista de casa
es.house_hint: Arrastra para girar · doble clic para restablecer
es.house_no_devices: Aún no hay dispositivos en esta habitación.
es.house_aria: Modelo 3D de la casa con %s plantas
es.house_err_no_floors: no se encontró ninguna planta válida (se esperaba "floors":[…])
es.house_err_dev_skipped: omitidos sin habitación o planta válida: %s

pl.house_plan_help: Rzut w metrach (x w prawo, y w dół), kondygnacje od dołu do góry. Puste = przykładowy dom. Przykład: {"floors":[{"id":"gf","name":"Parter","short":"0","h":2.7,"foot":[[0,0],[10,0],[10,8],[0,8]],"rooms":[{"id":"living","name":"Salon","p":[[0,0],[6,0],[6,5],[0,5]],"accent":"home"},{"id":"stairs","name":"Schody","kind":"stairs","p":[[6,0],[7,0],[7,3],[6,3]]}]}],"roof":{"base":"gf","pitch":35,"ridge":"x","knee":1}}. h = wysokość kondygnacji, foot = obrys kondygnacji, p = narożniki pomieszczenia, kind = room | outside | stairs, accent = home, grid, sun, heat, cool, ok … lub #rrggbb, "attic":true dla kondygnacji pod dachem, "roof" jest opcjonalny. Pisz {" bez spacji między { a ".
pl.house_devices_help: Lista urządzeń. Przykład: [{"id":"l1","type":"light","room":"living","uv":[0.5,0.5],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.light","label":"Lampa sufitowa"},{"id":"t1","type":"thermostat","room":"living","uv":[0.1,0.9],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.temp","oidSet":"0_userdata.0.living.setpoint"}]. type = light | plug | motion | window | thermostat | temperature | shutter. Pozycja: uv = [0…1, 0…1] wewnątrz pomieszczenia (0,0 = lewy górny róg pomieszczenia) lub at = [x, y] w metrach razem z "floor". oid = wyświetlany punkt danych; oidSet = punkt danych, do którego zapisują światła i gniazdka (domyślnie: oid), lub wartość zadana termostatu. Opcjonalnie: floor, label, unit, dec, icon, accent. Dotknięcie światła lub gniazdka przełącza je. Puste = urządzenia demo przykładowego domu.
pl.house_start_floor_tip: ID kondygnacji z rzutu; puste = wszystkie kondygnacje
pl.house_start_room_tip: ID pomieszczenia (lub kondygnacja/pomieszczenie); przy starcie otwiera widok pomieszczenia
pl.house_wall_height_tip: Część wysokości kondygnacji, którą otrzymują ściany w widoku rozłożonym
pl.house_no_devices: W tym pomieszczeniu nie ma jeszcze urządzeń.
pl.house_err_dev_skipped: pominięto bez prawidłowego pomieszczenia lub kondygnacji: %s

uk.house_plan_help: План поверхів у метрах (x праворуч, y вниз), поверхи знизу вгору. Порожньо = приклад будинку. Приклад: {"floors":[{"id":"gf","name":"Перший поверх","short":"1","h":2.7,"foot":[[0,0],[10,0],[10,8],[0,8]],"rooms":[{"id":"living","name":"Вітальня","p":[[0,0],[6,0],[6,5],[0,5]],"accent":"home"},{"id":"stairs","name":"Сходи","kind":"stairs","p":[[6,0],[7,0],[7,3],[6,3]]}]}],"roof":{"base":"gf","pitch":35,"ridge":"x","knee":1}}. h = висота поверху, foot = контур поверху, p = кути кімнати, kind = room | outside | stairs, accent = home, grid, sun, heat, cool, ok … або #rrggbb, "attic":true для поверху під дахом, "roof" необов'язковий. Пишіть {" без пробілу між { і ".
uk.house_devices_help: Список пристроїв. Приклад: [{"id":"l1","type":"light","room":"living","uv":[0.5,0.5],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.light","label":"Стельове світло"},{"id":"t1","type":"thermostat","room":"living","uv":[0.1,0.9],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.temp","oidSet":"0_userdata.0.living.setpoint"}]. type = light | plug | motion | window | thermostat | temperature | shutter. Положення: uv = [0…1, 0…1] усередині кімнати (0,0 = лівий верхній кут кімнати) або at = [x, y] у метрах разом із "floor". oid = точка даних, що відображається; oidSet = точка даних, у яку записують світильники й розетки (типово: oid), або задане значення термостата. Необов'язково: floor, label, unit, dec, icon, accent. Натискання на світильник або розетку перемикає їх. Порожньо = демо-пристрої прикладу будинку.
uk.house_start_floor_tip: ID поверху з плану; порожньо = усі поверхи
uk.house_start_room_tip: ID кімнати (або поверх/кімната); під час запуску відкриває вигляд кімнати
uk.house_wall_height_tip: Частка висоти поверху, яку отримують стіни в рознесеному вигляді
uk.house_hint: Перетягніть для обертання · подвійний клік — скидання
uk.house_no_devices: У цій кімнаті ще немає пристроїв.
uk.house_err_dev_skipped: пропущено без допустимої кімнати або поверху: %s

zh-cn.house_plan_help: 以米为单位的平面图（x 向右，y 向下），楼层从下到上排列。留空 = 示例房屋。示例：{"floors":[{"id":"gf","name":"一楼","short":"1F","h":2.7,"foot":[[0,0],[10,0],[10,8],[0,8]],"rooms":[{"id":"living","name":"客厅","p":[[0,0],[6,0],[6,5],[0,5]],"accent":"home"},{"id":"stairs","name":"楼梯","kind":"stairs","p":[[6,0],[7,0],[7,3],[6,3]]}]}],"roof":{"base":"gf","pitch":35,"ridge":"x","knee":1}}。h = 层高，foot = 楼层轮廓，p = 房间的角点，kind = room | outside | stairs, accent = home, grid, sun, heat, cool, ok … 或 #rrggbb，"attic":true 表示屋顶下的楼层，"roof" 为可选项。书写 {" 时，{ 与 " 之间不要有空格。
zh-cn.house_devices_help: 设备列表。示例：[{"id":"l1","type":"light","room":"living","uv":[0.5,0.5],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.light","label":"吸顶灯"},{"id":"t1","type":"thermostat","room":"living","uv":[0.1,0.9],"oid":"0_userdata.0.living.temp","oidSet":"0_userdata.0.living.setpoint"}]。type = light | plug | motion | window | thermostat | temperature | shutter。位置：uv = [0…1, 0…1] 表示房间内的位置（0,0 = 房间左上角），或 at = [x, y]（单位：米）并配合 "floor"。oid = 显示的数据点；oidSet = 灯和插座写入的数据点（默认：oid），或恒温器的设定值。可选：floor, label, unit, dec, icon, accent。点按灯或插座可切换其开关。留空 = 示例房屋的演示设备。
zh-cn.house_mode_switch: 房屋 / 分层展开切换
zh-cn.house_start_floor_tip: 平面图中某个楼层的 ID；留空 = 所有楼层
zh-cn.house_start_room_tip: 房间的 ID（或 楼层/房间）；启动时打开房间视图
zh-cn.house_wall_height_tip: 分层展开视图中墙体所占层高的比例
zh-cn.house_hint: 拖动旋转 · 双击重置
